program: playwright-cli run-code (Chromium, 1280x720), host responses simulated as protocol v2 messages

conclusions.edgeToEvidence: Selecting a Semantic edge asks for that relation's evidence and shows it; the edge occurrence count equals the paged total for a type-granularity edge.
conclusions.noAnalysisOnDetails: Zero analyze requests: opening details and paging evidence only read the stored result.
conclusions.quickVsSemantic: The basis is labelled (Semantic（解決済み参照）/ Quick（推定）) and inferred edges carry an explicit warning.
conclusions.verticalFlow: Edge → evidence → copy, edge → next page, node → dependencies → navigate, all in one session.

notVerifiedHere: Aggregated edges (namespace/project) show the per-relation breakdown; the browser fixture used type granularity, so the breakdown was verified by unit tests only.
Opening an evidence record in the editor is SD-019; the clipboard reference is the SD-018 deliverable.
